what: sandbox_ai retrieval cost, before and after caching token statistics and storing vectors as float32 blobs
host: Windows 11, Python 3.12, SQLite 3.45 (synthetic corpus, no network)
method: Store.search() on a generated corpus; timings are one warm-up-free call after import. Same corpus and same queries for both revisions.

lexical.note: first call pays for building counts/lengths/postings; every later query on an unchanged corpus is a postings lookup

semantic.note: before: JSON text parsed per query; after: float32 blobs decoded once per corpus generation. The remaining cost is the pure-Python dot product (no numpy dependency).

tests: the pre-optimisation scoring is kept as a reference implementation in tests/unit/ai/test_analysis.py (RetrievalCostTests) and the ranking must match exactly
